request.input:
Write an employer-facing cover letter tailored to this job. Use only candidate facts from the source. Preserve contribution level, shared results, dates, credential status and academic/project context. Do not turn job requirements into candidate history. Choose the strongest relevant evidence, retain useful concrete detail, and write clear natural professional English. Make a focused case through one or two relevant examples rather than reciting the résumé. Avoid generic praise and invented motivation. Use 2–4 paragraphs, at most 320 words, a salutation and signoff.

JOB

paragraphs: I am applying for the Plumbing Apprentice position with Example C03 Services. Since 2023, I have worked as a Plumbing Apprentice at Example Home Plumbing, assisting a licensed plumber with residential water-line repairs, fixture replacement and drain clearing. I also hold a Plumbing Techniques certificate from Example Trades College (2023).

In this supervised role, I have measured and cut copper and PEX pipe from the supervising plumber’s marked layouts, prepared joints, and recorded materials on work orders. During a supervised pressure check, I located a recurring under-sink leak by drying the fittings and checking each joint in sequence; the licensed plumber approved and completed the connection repair. This work reflects my experience supporting residential repairs under licensed supervision while following marked layouts and maintaining material records.

Previously, as a Warehouse Associate at Example Building Supply from 2021 to 2023, I picked plumbing fittings against order lists and checked part sizes before loading. I would welcome the opportunity to bring my pipe-preparation, fixture-assistance, supervised leak-check, and work-order recording experience to Example C03 Services.
